items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: LICENSE_NVIDIA at the repo root is the NVIDIA Source Code License for instant neural graphics primitives (non-commercial). The project is review-passed with no licence discussion in notes; a person must rule whether the NSCL-covered code affects tier standing and upstream contribution. UPSTREAM ANSWER (2026-08-26): the author states src/bvh.cu, include/gpu/triangle.cuh, and include/gpu/bounding_box.cuh borrow code from instant-ngp and LICENSE_NVIDIA was included for them; author open to a rewrite. Scope question answered; severity raised -- derived code is in the core, compiles on AMD, and our merged PR #33 touched bvh.cu.

Round-2 rewrite (c7379c0) regresses sdf_raystab +21-23% at 2M tris and +6-9% at 10k tris, and ray_trace +6-11% at 2M tris, on wave32 gfx1151; gfx90a wave64 saw neither. Query-kernel tuning was done on wave64. Correctness gates all pass. Rule: send back to porter for wave32 tuning, or accept and disclose.

Root cause of the wave32 perf regression is the two '#pragma unroll' lines on the fan-out-4 child loops in ray_intersect (VGPR 172->70, 171->73, occupancy 8->16 waves). Changing them to '#pragma unroll 1' makes the rewrite FASTER than the pre-rewrite code everywhere (big2m sdf_raystab -12.4%, med200k -19.6%). Similarity vs e5a657a provably unchanged (pragma lines are excluded from the metric). Decide: apply guarded by USE_ROCM (conservative, CUDA path untouched) or unguarded; either moves head_sha and forces fleet revalidation.
